reviews.title: Good for $160
reviews.comment:
Paid $160 for this in Oct 2025.  Writing review in April 2026.
Case seems great, airflow is good, it's sturdy, spacious, glad I purchased it.
Cons: It's HUGE, measure before you buy.

reviews.title: Quality Case Built With Good Materials
reviews.comment: I love this case! There’s a lot of little details they’ve put in this thing that make building/upgrading a breeze.. with that being said it does have some downfalls… 1 it’s ginormous so make sure you have room to set it somewhere. I recommend a stand of some kind beside your desk to put it on… it’s also worth noting that it is a heavy boy… so make sure you have a firm grip… that loop on the back definitely serves its purpose well… before buying this case keep in mind that because of its size… most standard psu and fan cable lengths will not work for this case if you want to cable manage effectively… I found myself having to route my cpu cables up the back of the motherboard across the cpu backplate to get them to reach the top of the case from the psu so definitely be looking to buy longer cables as well it’ll save you some frustration and keep things tidy.. other than that… I can’t find anything wrong with the quality of the case.. super solid and has plenty of space to cram pretty much anything you want in there… it will house a 420mm radiator but only in the front and the way I understand it you have to buy the non-flow version to get the bracket for a rad of that size..
reviews.author: Toby Pendley
